learner_memberships_role_check.name: learner_memberships_role_check
learner_memberships_role_check.value:
(
        ("learner_memberships"."entity_type" = 'product' AND "learner_memberships"."role" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("learner_memberships"."entity_type" = 'community' AND "learner_memberships"."role" IN ('comment', 'post', 'moderate'))
      )

learner_memberships_included_parent_chec.name: learner_memberships_included_parent_check
learner_memberships_included_parent_chec.value: "learner_memberships"."is_included_in_plan" = false OR ("learner_memberships"."entity_type" = 'product' AND "learner_memberships"."parent_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_memberships"."payment_plan_id" IS NOT NULL)

school_accounts_contact_activated_check.name: school_accounts_contact_activated_check
school_accounts_contact_activated_check.value: "school_accounts"."sendlit_contact_id" IS NULL OR "school_accounts"."contact_activated_at" IS NOT NULL

storefront_checkout_sessions_resource_ch.name: storefront_checkout_sessions_resource_check
storefront_checkout_sessions_resource_ch.value: ("storefront_checkout_sessions"."entity_type" = 'product' AND "storefront_checkout_sessions"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "storefront_checkout_sessions"."community_id" IS NULL) OR ("storefront_checkout_sessions"."entity_type" = 'community' AND "storefront_checkout_sessions"."product_id" IS NULL AND "storefront_checkout_sessions"."community_id" IS NOT NULL)

storefront_plans_active_subscription_mon.name: storefront_plans_active_subscription_monthly_uidx
storefront_plans_active_subscription_mon.where: "storefront_plans"."entity_type" = 'product' AND "storefront_plans"."status" = 'active' AND "storefront_plans"."kind" = 'subscription' AND "storefront_plans"."subscription_monthly_amount" IS NOT NULL

storefront_plans_active_subscription_yea.name: storefront_plans_active_subscription_yearly_uidx
storefront_plans_active_subscription_yea.where: "storefront_plans"."entity_type" = 'product' AND "storefront_plans"."status" = 'active' AND "storefront_plans"."kind" = 'subscription' AND "storefront_plans"."subscription_yearly_amount" IS NOT NULL

storefront_plans_shape_check.name: storefront_plans_shape_check
storefront_plans_shape_check.value:
(
        ("storefront_plans"."kind" = 'free' AND "storefront_plans"."amount_minor" = 0 AND "storefront_plans"."billing_interval" IS NULL AND "storefront_plans"."installment_count" IS NULL)
        OR ("storefront_plans"."kind" = 'one_time' AND "storefront_plans"."amount_minor" > 0 AND "storefront_plans"."billing_interval" IS NULL AND "storefront_plans"."installment_count" IS NULL)
        OR ("storefront_plans"."kind" = 'subscription' AND "storefront_plans"."amount_minor" > 0 AND "storefront_plans"."billing_interval" IN ('month', 'year') AND "storefront_plans"."installment_count" IS NULL)
        OR ("storefront_plans"."kind" = 'installment' AND "storefront_plans"."amount_minor" > 0 AND "storefront_plans"."billing_interval" IN ('month', 'year') AND "storefront_plans"."installment_count" >= 2)
      )

billing_reconciliation_jobs_exactly_one_.name: billing_reconciliation_jobs_exactly_one_subject
billing_reconciliation_jobs_exactly_one_.value: ((CASE WHEN "billing_reconciliation_jobs"."checkout_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN "billing_reconciliation_jobs"."plan_change_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN "billing_reconciliation_jobs"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN "billing_reconciliation_jobs"."provider_customer_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) = 1
